criteria.question: Does the SEQUENCING earn Experiment 8's gain, or does merely obtaining structural information earn it? K-multistep is compared against L-static-onestep, which buys the same real structural evidence at the same price without any conditional chain.

notes: Ablation of Experiment 8. L receives the SAME structural channel and the same 0.5 price as K; the only difference is that K acquires it conditionally on a prior probe. Any gain K shows over L is attributable to sequencing and to nothing else.
